title: S4-FX-06 — Tiles agree with their map.
goal: Slicing the 16 x 16 Bun into 8 px tiles reports 4 unique tiles in a 2 x 2 grid and offers the tileset with its maps; slicing never changes the artwork; slicing again at 16 px reports a single tile, so the result follows the chosen size.

steps.why: Bun's four 8 x 8 quarters are all different.

steps.text: Includes tileset.png, zero-based tilemap.json and Tiled map.tmj.

steps.why: The export is ready; this plan does not start the browser download (the file itself is checked outside the App run).
Slicing and downloading never change the drawing.
At 16 px the whole canvas is one tile: the result follows the chosen size.
